title.narrative: Emergency Response for Flood Affected Communities in Marsabit and Wajir Counties in Kenya - PACIDA

description.narrative: The proposed project aims to save lives, provide immediate relief and support to vulnerable households impacted by the floods in Marsabit – North Horr Subcounty and Wajir’s Wajir West Sub counties. This response was chosen based on a rapid needs assessment by the National Draught Management Authority, County governments and development partners, that involved the community through the Participatory Vulnerability and Capacity Assessment (PVCA) and Supporting Community Led Response (SCLR) in the two counties and during which the community prioritized their needs for assistance. The assessment included the scale of the flooding, the severity of its impact on target communities, and the urgent need for assistance. Currently, most affected households have been put in camps and others moved to identified higher grounds. Humanitarian needs are on the rise as more areas are affected by the floods. Due to the widespread humanitarian needs caused by flooding in Marsabit and Wajir County the proposed project will focus on multi sectoral emergency assistance, prioritising food security, Non-Food Items (NFIs), WASH, access to essential services, and Protection. The approach integrates immediate lifesaving assistance, early recovery actions as well as prevention and mitigation of further humanitarian crisis.
